# has author

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasAuthor`](gmeow-hasAuthor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasAuthor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)

Relates a creative work to an agent chiefly responsible for creating its intellectual content. A flat shortcut subproperty of [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md)

Use [`gmeow:hasAuthor`](gmeow-hasAuthor.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
